entries.reason: Same test (271): a RETURN that succeeds ends the task, so the arm where RESP is NORMAL is never executed.

`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after `RETURN TRANSID('OCRA') COMMAREA(WS-COMM-AREA) LENGTH(21)` (263-269): RETURN never comes back on success, so the test runs only when RETURN itself fails, and IBM documents no RESP for it with a 21-byte COMMAREA and an installed TRANSID.
`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after the SEND MAP ERASE (648 on): IBM raises no condition for a map the program has just built from its own BNK1CDO, and no fault can be injected on it.
`IF SEND-DATAONLY` tests the 88 on the flag value '2' (line 51), set by no statement: only `SET SEND-ERASE` (188) and `SET SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` (244, 354) write the flag.
The RESP test inside the `IF SEND-DATAONLY` block (722), which is never entered.
The RESP test inside the `IF SEND-DATAONLY` block (722), which is never entered.
`IF SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM` is reached only with the flag '3': '1' (SEND-ERASE) leaves SM010 after the first SEND MAP and '2' is never set (see 722), so the test is always true.

`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after the SEND MAP DATAONLY ALARM (796 on): IBM raises no condition for a map the program has just built from its own BNK1CDO, and no fault can be injected on it.

`IF WS-CICS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL)` after the SEND TEXT ERASE FREEKB that writes the termination message (876-882): IBM raises no condition for it on a terminal that just sent a map, and no fault can be injected on it.
